name: China Times Publishing Comp.
summary: China Times Publishing Company specializes in the creation and global distribution of Chinese-language books, serving both its domestic market in Taiwan and international readerships. Its comprehensive catalog features an incredibly diverse array of subjects. This includes traditional literary forms like fiction, prose, and biographical accounts, alongside academic disciplines such as history, law, politics, philosophy, religion, and broader humanities and social studies. The company also delves into arts and culture, offering titles on art, photography, cinema, and television, complemented by multimedia products including DVDs, VCDs, and CDs. Educational content forms a significant part of their offerings, encompassing nature, popular science, mathematics, travel guides, and general knowledge, as well as dedicated learning encyclopedias, children's books, picture books, and fairy tales. For personal development and lifestyle interests, their catalog covers subjects such as parenting, gender medicine, health, beauty, diet, leisure, entertainment, psychology, and inspirational guides, alongside niche areas like astrology, marketing trends, and finance. Furthermore, they cover a variety of other miscellaneous subjects, from stationery to retail-related themes. Established in 1975, China Times Publishing Company maintains its operational base in Taipei, Taiwan.
